recentItems.title: 8000 Brazil Homes Blown Away, Entire Town Wiped Out In Supercell Storm Fury | Deaths, Scary Scenes
recentItems.description:
A powerful supercell storm has devastated the Brazilian town of Tupancireta, killing at least five people and damaging nearly 8,000 homes. The scale of destruction has prompted the deployment of around 200 military personnel to help clear debris and assist with the aftermath. The devastating storm has left the town grappling with widespread damage and a massive cleanup operation.

recentItems.title: Trump's Big Reaction As Huang Returns As Nvidia CEO, Calls Him 'Great Patriot' Amid Controversy
recentItems.description:
NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang has announced his return, thanking the company's board for its confidence and support. US President Donald Trump has welcomed the decision, calling Huang a "Great Patriot" and "National Treasure". Trump also said the US government has no evidence of unlawful conduct by Huang, while stressing the need for NVIDIA to continue its internal investigation into compliance with US export controls.
